title: Build a native editable workflow slide
objective: Create one native-editable PPTX slide from the supplied outline; do not substitute a screenshot.
audience: Technical operator and local implementation agents
context: Sanitized demonstration fixture. No actual client data, production repository or account state is represented.

frozen: Preserve the stated scope and output IDs.
Clearly distinguish performed work from suggested steps.
exclusions: Do not use Work or Codex
implementation_freedom: Choose concise explanatory wording unless exact text is supplied.

authorization.approval_basis: Synthetic/public example content authored for this release; approval applies only to these fixture bytes.

payload.build_brief: Build a light 16:9 slide with a title and three-node workflow from the attached outline.
payload.native_requirements: All text, boxes and connectors must be native editable objects.
validation: Inspect native objects rather than checking only the extension.
Render and inspect for clipping and connector alignment.

acceptance: Exactly one slide with native editable title, node labels and arrow connectors.
Render/inspect the slide and report any font substitution.
